theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : Euclid n → ℝ) (x : Euclid n) (ρ K : ℝ), 0 < n → 0 < ρ → DifferentiableAt ℝ u x → ContinuousOn u (closedBall x (3 * ρ / 2)) → (∀ z ∈ closedBall x (3 * ρ / 2), |u z| ≤ K) → (∀ z ∈ closedBall x (ρ / 2), ∫ y in ball z ρ, u y = (volume (ball z ρ)).toReal * u z) → ‖fderiv ℝ u x‖ ≤ 2 * (n : ℝ) * K / ρ
